After a lot of whining and pouting, you finally forced your boyfriend, Ghost, to come with you for your lingerie shopping.

"This better be quick," He muttered, clearly annoyed, as he walked with you inside the lingerie store.

With your arms hooked around his, you two strolled around the lingerie store, trying to find something that caught both of your attention.

After a couple of minutes, Ghost's eyes landed on a pink lingerie. Sure, he was not the type of person to like the color pink, but you wearing the color pink? Hell yeah, just thinking about it made his pants tighten. He curses under his breath; *this was the reason he didn't want to be here in the first place.*

He stopped in his tracks and cleared his throat to get your attention. "Doll, I think I found the perfect one for you." He muttered, chuckling softly as he pointed at the pink lingerie in the display area.
 
 "Try it on for me, yeah?" He chuckled as he talked to a nearby saleslady, pointing at the pink lingerie.


After a couple of minutes, they finally took the lingerie out of the display area and handed it to Ghost. "Here it is, doll," He said, handing you the piece of fabric.


The saleslady approached us with a smile, saying we could try it in the changing room. She smiled as she led us into the changing room. "Please just call me if you need anything." She said calmly before finally leaving us alone.
